description: This file contains utility functions for serializing R objects into a format suitable for Java, including type mapping, writing various data types, and handling complex objects like lists, environments, and date/time objects. It appears to be part of a serialization module for R-Java interoperability within a Spark environment.

methods.name: getSerdeType
methods.description: Determines the serialization type of an R object, mapping R types to Java types or arrays.

methods.name: writeObject
methods.description: Serializes an R object to a connection, handling various data types and complex structures.

methods.name: writeVoid
methods.description: Handles serialization of NULL values.

methods.name: writeJobj
methods.description: Serializes a backend-created object, identified by its id.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Serializes a string value to a connection.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Serializes an integer value.

methods.name: writeDouble
methods.description: Serializes a double value.

methods.name: writeBoolean
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value as an integer.

methods.name: writeRawSerialize
methods.description: Serializes an R object into raw bytes using R's serialize function.

methods.name: writeRowSerialize
methods.description: Serializes a list of rows into raw bytes.

methods.name: serializeRow
methods.description: Serializes a single row (list) into raw bytes.

methods.name: writeRaw
methods.description: Serializes raw byte data to a connection.

methods.name: writeType
methods.description: Writes a type indicator byte to a connection based on the class.

methods.name: writeArray
methods.description: Serializes an array of homogeneous elements.

methods.name: writeList
methods.description: Serializes a list of objects, possibly of different types.

methods.name: writeEnv
methods.description: Serializes an environment (hash map) as a list of keys and values.

methods.name: writeDate
methods.description: Serializes a Date object.

methods.name: writeTime
methods.description: Serializes POSIXct or POSIXlt time objects.

methods.name: writeArgs
methods.description: Serializes a list of arguments of various types.

methods.name: writeSerializeInArrow
methods.description: Serializes a data frame into Arrow format if the 'arrow' package is available.
